threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a warm pint in a tin can is a good idea. The locals are eyeing your choice like it’s a crime against humanity.
Caught the 68 last night; a bloke was loudly arguing with his reflection in the window. Weirdly, we all got silent, like we were in on his madness.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the Turkish market on a Sunday, I caught the scent of roasted chestnuts mixing with the sound of a street musician—it hit me then, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have vintage ads that feel like stepping back in time? It's a living museum under our feet.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows that the best tacos are from the stand by the BART entrance, not the shiny new joint everyone raves about.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy trying to feed a feral cat from his Muni transfer while the bus rattled over a pothole. Only in SF do you see cat lovers multi-tasking like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just all about Gaudí. They miss the real charm in the little plazas where locals gather for a quiet evening.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their insistence on calling it "La Rambla," not realizing it’s just "Rambla" for locals. Always dropping the definite article.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the overground.' Trust me, locals will pick up on that.
Heard a guy on the 59 last night ranting about how 'the future is electric' right before he fell asleep and drooled on his own jacket.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I found myself dodging a street musician's saxophone on Karl-Marx-Straße while debating the best falafel in town. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Kebab shop that serves late-night vegan döner made from seitan. A staple for the night owls and foodies alike!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: When they instinctively check the BART Delays app before deciding which bar to hit. A true local feels that late-night scramble.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni today with a jazz band playing on the bus. Even the driver was tapping the wheel, but we all got held up later by a dog on the tracks.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals love the Barça games. Many of us would rather enjoy a quiet evening at a corner bar with pals than fight the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how to pay for a ticket on the metro. The confusion at the machines is classic.
